with open('json/superhero.json', 'r') as f:

            hero_id = hero['id']
            break

    next(reader)

        power_names[row[0]] = row[1]
superpowers = [power_names[pid] for pid in hero_powers if pid in power_names]
print('\n'.join(sorted(superpowers)))"}
